name: Acceleration
measures: Whether growth itself is speeding up.
formula: Acc = WoW today − WoW 7 days ago
read: Earliest sign of a turn.

name: Advance-decline
measures: How many creators in a topic are rising against how many are falling.
formula: Creators whose last 7 days beat the 7 before − creators whose last 7 days fell short
read: Positive and growing means the whole topic is rising, not one creator.

name: Attention
measures: Views gained in a day by every tracked video in a topic and its sub-topics.
formula: A(k,t) = sum of views gained on day t by videos in k and below
read: The headline daily number for any topic.

name: Audit error rate
measures: How often the classifier was wrong in the latest hand audit, by sector.
formula: Wrong codes ÷ items checked in the audit sample
read: Above 15% flags a prompt or codebook fix for that sector.

name: Base-rate comparison
measures: Whether the calls beat chance.
formula: Hit rate ÷ hit rate of the same rule on random topics on the same dates
read: Above 1 means the signal beats chance.

name: Basket coverage
measures: How much of a topic's total views the terminal sees.
formula: Tracked views ÷ outside estimate of total views, same period

name: Breakout
measures: A video beating both its creator and its market.
formula: Outlier ≥ 3 and views ≥ 90th percentile of its topic at the same age
read: Both conditions must hold.

name: Calibration
measures: Whether stated probabilities were honest.
formula: Brier = average of (p − outcome)²
read: Lower is better; 0.25 = coin flip.

name: Opportunity score
measures: How attractive a niche is: growing and under-supplied.
formula: CCOS = 20 × NGP × (1 − SI)
read: 10 is a flat niche at median saturation. Higher is better.

name: CCOS change
measures: CCOS today vs 7 days ago.
formula: CHG% = CCOS today ÷ CCOS 7 days ago − 1
read: Trend is UP above +3%, DOWN below −3%.

name: Confidence interval
measures: How sure the terminal is about a topic's week-over-week growth.
formula: Resample the topic's creators 1,000 times; 5th to 95th percentile of WoW
read: Quote the range, not the point, in a memo or LP update.

name: Content Index
measures: A topic's attention over time on a fixed basket of creators, base 100.
formula: I(t) = I(t−1) × matched attention today ÷ matched attention yesterday
read: Comparable over time; new creators don't move it.

name: Composite index
measures: One index across platforms.
formula: Σ platform weight × platform index; weight = share of tracked followers, reset quarterly

name: Classification confidence
measures: How much of a topic's attention comes from videos the classifier was confident about.
formula: Attention from videos classified with confidence ≥ 0.7 ÷ all attention
read: Low values mean the topic's figures rest on uncertain codes.

name: Coverage
measures: Channels behind the numbers, per niche.
formula: Tracked, added in 7 days, and screening verdicts per niche
read: Read any figure alongside the coverage behind it.

name: Top-3 concentration
measures: Top 3 creators' share of a topic's attention.
formula: Sum of the 3 largest creator shares of Σ28 A
read: High means a few creators own the topic.

name: Creator Viability Score
measures: How investable a creator looks, 0 to 100.
formula: 25 momentum + 20 consistency + 20 audience depth + 20 market opportunity + 15 hit dependence, each a niche percentile
read: Watch 60+, Priority 75+ for 14 days, Diligence-ready 85+ for 28 days.

name: Decay and half-life
measures: How fast a video's daily views fall after upload.
formula: Fit ln ΔV(age) = c − λ·age over days 1-30; half-life = ln 2 ÷ λ
read: Short half-life = news-like; long = evergreen.

name: Topic drift
measures: Whether a creator is pivoting away from their niche.
formula: Share of last-90-day uploads outside the primary niche − the same share a year earlier
read: Positive and large = a pivot.

name: Demand Signal Score
measures: How unusual a topic's buying-oriented attention is today.
formula: 0.4 z(WoW of IA) + 0.2 z(Acc) + 0.2 z(ΔShare) + 0.2 z(NCS)
read: 0 is normal for the topic. Alert at 2+ for 5 days.

name: Earnings estimate
measures: A range for a creator's ad earnings over 90 days.
formula: Long-form views ÷ 1,000 × RPM band + Shorts views ÷ 1,000 × Shorts RPM band
read: Always a range and labeled with its RPM source. Bands are placeholders until replaced.

name: Entity attention
measures: Daily attention on videos naming a brand, company or product.
formula: Σ ΔV of videos whose title, tags or description name the entity
read: The bridge from topics to companies.

name: Equal-weight index
measures: A topic's index if every creator counted equally.
formula: I_eq(t) = I_eq(t−1) × mean over matched creators of A(t) ÷ A(t−1)
read: Reads breadth: how the typical creator is doing.

name: Evergreen share
measures: Share of a video's views that came after its first 30 days.
formula: 1 − views at day 30 ÷ views now (videos older than 90 days)
read: High = library value that keeps earning.

name: Smoothed trend
measures: A topic's daily attention with day-to-day noise smoothed out, weighting recent days most.
read: Use for charts and to see a turn before the 7-day average shows it.

name: Creator flow
measures: Creators moving into or out of a topic.
formula: Creators whose share of uploads in the topic rose by > 20 points over 90 days − those whose share fell by > 20
read: Creators move toward demand; this sees it before the views do.

name: Predictive test
measures: Whether attention improves a forecast of the outcome beyond the outcome's own history.
formula: F-test on lagged attention (p < 0.05) and a lower out-of-sample error on the last 25% of weeks
read: The standard of proof for LPs.

name: Concentration index
measures: How concentrated a topic's attention is across creators.
formula: Σ (creator share × 100)²
read: Under 1,500 competitive; 1,500 to 2,500 moderate; over 2,500 concentrated.

name: Hit rate
measures: Share of resolved calls that came true.
formula: Calls where the outcome moved the called way by more than its typical 13-week move within the horizon ÷ calls resolved
read: The headline track record.

name: Intent-weighted attention
measures: Attention weighted by how buying-oriented each video's format is.
formula: Σ views gained × format weight (reviews 1.0, tutorials 0.6, other 0.2)
read: The demand input to DSS.

name: Lead-lag
measures: How many weeks a topic's attention runs ahead of an outcome.
formula: ρ(L) = corr(Δlog IA(t − L), Δlog Y(t)), L = 0-26 weeks, at least 16 overlapping weeks; L* = highest ρ
read: The lead time to expect for each category.

name: Lead time
measures: How early the calls were.
formula: Median days from call to the outcome first crossing its threshold

name: New-creator share
measures: Share of a topic's attention won by creators new to it.
formula: Σ28 A from creators new to the topic ÷ Σ28 A
inputs: 28 days; new = first upload in topic within 90 days
read: High means the topic is still open to newcomers.

name: Growth
measures: Views gained in the last 7 days vs the 7 before.
formula: NGP = Σ7 A ÷ prior Σ7 A
read: 1.00 is flat; 1.20 is 20% growth.

name: Outlier score
measures: A video's views vs its creator's norm at the same age.
formula: O = views at age a ÷ median views of the creator's last 30 videos at age a
read: 1.0 is typical; 3.0 is three times the norm.

name: Purchase-intent comments
measures: How often viewers ask where to buy, the price, a link or availability.
formula: Purchase-intent comments ÷ comments sampled (up to 100 per video)
read: Off until switched on; costs API quota.

name: Packaging format
measures: Which title format a video uses and how that format performs in its topic.
formula: Draft CTNCS v3 packaging code per title; median outlier score and breakout rate by packaging
read: Shows which packaging wins in each topic. Codes are a draft.

name: Platform attention
measures: A topic's attention on each platform.
formula: A(k, t, p), section 3 rules per platform

name: Normalized attention
measures: A platform's movement against its own history.
formula: z = (log weekly A − 26-week mean) ÷ standard deviation
read: Platforms count views differently; compare movement.

name: Platform lead
measures: Which platform moves first in a topic.
formula: 6.6 lead-lag between platforms' weekly attention

name: Pull completeness
measures: Whether the daily pull reached every tracked channel.
formula: Channels snapshotted ÷ channels tracked, per day
read: Below 1.0 means some numbers that day are partial.

name: Risk
measures: Volatility and concentration of a niche.
formula: Average of the percentile ranks of volatility and CR3, split into thirds
read: LOW, MEDIUM or HIGH.

name: Relative strength
measures: A topic's index against its parent's.
formula: RS = I(topic) ÷ I(parent) × 100
read: Above 100 means outperforming its sector.

name: Share of attention
measures: A topic's attention as a share of its parent topic's.
formula: S = A(topic) ÷ A(parent); change in points vs 28 days ago
read: Removes platform-wide swings. Rising share means the topic is gaining.

name: Saturation
measures: Content made per unit of audience demand, 0 to 1.
formula: x = uploads ÷ (views gained ÷ 1,000); SI = x ÷ (x + median x)
read: 0.5 is the median niche. Above 0.5 is crowded.

name: Spike z-score
measures: How far today's channel views are above the last 28 days.
formula: z = (today − 28-day mean) ÷ 28-day standard deviation
read: Alert at 3σ+ and 2× a typical day.

name: Structural break splice
measures: How much a platform's counting change moved a topic's attention.
formula: s = median daily A in the 14 days after the break ÷ median in the 14 days before
read: Divide pre-break attention by s to compare across the break. Blank until both sides have data.

name: Subscriber change
measures: Subscriber growth corrected for YouTube rounding public counts to 3 significant figures.
formula: Step r = 10^(digits − 3); report a change only when it is at least r; spread each step over the days since the last one
read: Small channels move in visible steps; large ones only every few days. Read the estimate, not the raw change.

name: Market temperature
measures: The overall mood across niches.
formula: HOT if average CCOS > 12, WARM if > 8, else COOL
read: A one-word read of the whole market.

name: Minimum sample
measures: Flags topics too small to read.
formula: THIN if fewer than 30 videos with gains or 5 creators in 28 days
read: Treat a THIN topic's figures as unreliable.

name: Trend index
measures: The Content Index smoothed over 7 days.
formula: Geometric average of the last 7 daily index levels
read: The headline line on charts.

name: Content supply
measures: Minutes of video published in the niche.
formula: Σ28 minutes published by tracked channels
read: More minutes means more competition for attention.

name: Vs niche
measures: A creator's growth minus its niche's median growth.
formula: G28(creator) − median G28 of the niche
read: Positive means outgrowing the niche.

name: Week-over-week growth
measures: Attention in the last 7 days vs the 7 days before.
formula: WoW = Σ7 A ÷ prior Σ7 A − 1
read: Shown as CHG% for topics. NGP = WoW + 1.

name: Topic-to-market crosswalk
measures: Which consumer categories, industries and companies each niche maps to.
formula: Hand-maintained table: niche → categories, NAICS codes, public companies, private brands
read: Draft. Links a niche's demand signal to the markets it should lead.
